title: Flash SegaSaturn Vol. 32
native_title: フラッシュ・セガサターン Ｖｏｌ．３２
overview:
Flash SegaSaturn Vol. 32 is a free Japanese demo disc from Sega that collects a trial version and previews of Saturn games.

Playable demo:
- Kidou Senkan Nadesico: The Blank of 3 Years

Non-playable previews:
- Shining Force III Scenario 3: Hyouheki no Jashinguu
- Simulation RPG Tkool
- Capcom Generation Dai-2-shuu: Makai to Kishi
- Digital Monster Ver. S: Digimon Tamers
- BackGuiner: Yomigaeru Yuusha-tachi Hishou-hen "Uragiri no Senjou"
- Millennium Fire
- Segata Sanshirou Shinken Yuugi
- A look at Satakore titles
